fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone number
fields.description: Shown as a tap-to-call link on phones.

fields.name: givingUrl
fields.label: Online giving link
fields.description: The Subsplash giving page. Do not change unless Subsplash gives you a new address.

fields.name: connectionCardUrl
fields.label: Connection Card form link
fields.description: The Planning Center form behind every "I'm interested" button.

fields.name: serveFormUrl
fields.label: Join the Team form link
fields.description: The Planning Center form behind every "Join the serve team" button.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Page title (shown in the browser tab)

fields.name: metaDescription
fields.label: Description for Google
fields.description: One sentence. Google shows this under the page title in search results.

fields.name: layout
fields.label: Card layout
fields.description: How the cards on this page are arranged. "One per row" suits a list of ministries; "Side by side" suits shorter cards.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Describe the picture
fields.description: For people using a screen reader. Say what is in it.

fields.name: linkUrl
fields.label: Button link (optional)
fields.description: Type @tel to call the office, @mailto to email it, or paste a web address.

fields.name: items
fields.label: List of items in this section

fields.name: linkUrl
fields.label: Link address (optional)
fields.description: Type @tel to call the office, @mailto to email it, or paste a web address.

fields.name: date
fields.label: Which Sunday is this issue for?
fields.description: Pick the Sunday. The web address and the order on the page both come from this.

fields.name: pages
fields.label: The pictures
fields.description: Upload the same pictures you already make each week, in reading order — front page first.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: What is on this page?
fields.description: A few words for someone using a screen reader, who cannot see the picture at all. e.g. "Front page: schedule, sermon and Sunday classes".

fields.name: summary
fields.label: One line about this week (optional)
fields.description: Shown under the date, and used when somebody shares the link. e.g. "Lord's Supper, the Pumpkin Patch work day, and ActivStars sign-ups."

fields.name: highlights
fields.label: A few things worth typing out (optional)
fields.description: A picture cannot be read aloud by a phone, searched, or enlarged well on a small screen. Three or four lines here cover the things nobody should miss. Leave it empty on a busy week — the pictures still work.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
